notice_body_free: PocketMesh is free software. It costs nothing to download or use.
notice_body_refund: If you paid for PocketMesh, you were sold a copy by someone who had no right to sell it. Please ask them, or the store you bought it from, for a refund.
notice_body_official: The official version is always free at %1$s and on the project's GitHub releases page. You can find links to both in the About menu.
notice_body_business: Using PocketMesh in a business / commercial setting or need a customized version? Please get in touch.
notice_checkbox_label: I have read and understand this message. Don't show it again.
about_show_notice_again: Show the free software notice again
about_show_notice_again_subtitle: Click to read the notice about PocketMesh being free software
settings_language_description: The language PocketMesh's own screens are shown in. Remote devices, servers, and file names are shown as they are. Does not affect language shown in the MeshCentral web interface.
settings_downloads_private_storage: Saving to the app's private storage (not visible in other file apps, removed if the app is uninstalled)
settings_downloads_description: Files downloaded from a device's file browser are saved here. Choosing a folder uses Android's own folder picker, so downloads land somewhere visible in your regular file manager (e.g. Downloads) and survive uninstalling the app. If not set, uses the app-private location which is not normally accessible by anything besides the app and isn't preserved on uninstall.
settings_security_description: Require a fingerprint or face check before PocketMesh automatically signs you back in.
settings_biometric_available: Use fingerprint/face unlock before auto-signing in
settings_biometric_unavailable: No biometric method is set up on this device
settings_sessions_description: Keep an open terminal, desktop, or files session connected in the background (a persistent notification appears while a session is open) so it survives the screen turning off or switching to another app. Automatic reconnect for a session that drops stays on either way.
settings_desktop_description: How a one-finger drag controls the remote cursor when you open a device's Desktop screen. You can always switch for just the current session from its own menu (⋮ > Input mode) without changing this default.
input_mode_trackpad_description: Drag moves the cursor relatively, like a laptop trackpad. Precise for small targets.
input_mode_direct_touch_description: This mode allows your finger to be the cursor so you can touch and drag exactly where you want it.
settings_twofinger_description: What dragging with two fingers does on a device's Desktop screen. Pinch-to-zoom works either way. You can always switch for just the current session from its own menu (⋮ > Two-finger drag) without changing this default.
twofinger_pan_view_description: Two fingers pan and zoom your local view of the remote screen, without sending anything to the remote machine.
twofinger_scroll_remote_description: Two fingers scroll the remote machine's mouse wheel instead of panning your view. Pinch-to-zoom still works.
settings_combos_description: Build your own key sequences (e.g. a chord like Ctrl+Alt+Del, or even a bunch of plain keys like all four arrows) to send from a device's Desktop screen.
device_message_box_description: Unlike a toast, this pops a dialog on the device's screen that the user has to dismiss.
device_power_restart_confirm_body: This restarts %1$s right away. Anyone using it will lose unsaved work, and any open desktop, terminal, or file sessions to it will disconnect.
device_power_sleep_confirm_body: This puts %1$s to sleep right away. Any open desktop, terminal, or file sessions to it will disconnect, and it will stay unreachable until it's woken (Wake only works if the device supports Wake-on-LAN).
device_power_shut_down_confirm_body: This shuts down %1$s right away. Anyone using it will lose unsaved work, and it will stay off until it's powered back on (Wake only works if the device supports Wake-on-LAN).
device_uninstall_confirm_body: This tells %1$s's MeshCentral agent to remove itself. The device will stop being manageable until the agent is reinstalled. This can't be undone from here.
device_remove_confirm_body: This deletes %1$s's record, notes, and history from this MeshCentral account. It does not uninstall the agent. If the MeshCentral agent is still installed, the device may show up again the next time it connects. This can't be undone.
details_no_data: No hardware details are available for this device yet. This is normal if it hasn't reported an inventory since it was last online.
details_no_response: The server didn't respond to the details request. Try Refresh, or check your connection.
details_no_software: No software inventory available for this device.
events_none: No events found for this device.
login_error_url_key: This server requires a URL access key, which isn't supported yet.
login_error_banned: Too many attempts. This IP is temporarily banned by the server.
login_error_locked: Too many failed attempts. This account is temporarily locked by the server.
login_error_notools: This account isn't permitted to use API/CLI-style clients.
login_error_email_validation: Verify the account's email address before logging in.
net_tunnel_timeout: Timed out waiting for the device to connect.
files_download_failed_not_found: Download failed: file not found, or this account isn't allowed to access files on this device.
service_channel_description: Shown while a terminal, desktop, or files session is kept open in the background
restore_nothing_new: Nothing new to restore, the current app config contains everything in that backup file already.
backup_error_folder_inaccessible: The backup folder is no longer accessible.
backup_error_folder_not_writable: The backup folder is no longer writable.
backup_error_open_folder: Couldn't open the backup folder for writing.
connect_server_closed: Server closed the connection (check credentials, URL, or 2FA code).
connect_timed_out: Connection timed out. Check the server URL and your network connection.
backup_location_description: Where backup files are saved on this device.
backup_manual_description: Saves your server list, custom key combos, and app preferences to the folder above. Login sessions and Login Tokens aren't included in any backups (nor can they be exported).
backup_auto_choose_folder_first: Choose a backup folder above first.
backup_auto_description: Runs quietly in the background on the schedule below.
backup_restore_description: Loads a backup file's server list, custom key combos, and preferences on top of what's already in the app. Nothing existing is removed or overwritten by the restore process. Restored servers still require you to sign in with a valid username/password/mfa/login token, just like you did the first time you added them.
login_history_tokens_description: Tokens minted from this or other devices via "stay signed in". They are used instead of your real password so this app never has to store it or ask for a 2FA code again.
login_history_revoke_confirm_body: "%1$s" will stop working immediately. Any device or session using it will need to sign in again.
login_event_bad_2fa: Login attempt with an incorrect 2FA code
login_event_locked_account: Login attempt on a locked account
combos_empty: No custom key combos yet. Tap + above to build one. You need to provide a name plus any sequence of keys to be sent to the device one after another when you pick it from the Desktop screen's Send Key Combo menu.
combos_delete_confirm_body: "%1$s" will be removed from the Send Key Combo menu on every device. This can't be undone.
combo_editor_no_steps: Nothing added yet. Tap the keys below to build the sequence.
combo_editor_add_key_description: Hold any modifiers for the next key, then tap a key to add it to the sequence.
accounts_empty: No saved accounts yet. Tap + above to add one.
accounts_known_servers_description: These are from a restored backup and do not have saved credentials. Tap one to add it.
accounts_remove_confirm: Remove the saved login for %1$s on %2$s?
accounts_remove_confirm_current: Remove the saved login for %1$s on %2$s? You're currently connected with it and this will disconnect you.
account_error_password_confirm: Enter the password to confirm this change.
account_login_token_hint: A MeshCentral Login Token works here too. If using a token, you can set a Display name below so it doesn't show as that raw token everywhere.
account_totp_secret_invalid: That doesn't look like a valid setup key. Please double-check for typos.
account_allow_insecure_warning: This is insecure and should only use for a server you trust on a private network.
login_error_required: Server, username, and password are required.
login_get_started: Get started by adding your MeshCentral server.
biometric_subtitle: Use your fingerprint or face to sign in
devices_empty: No devices yet, or still loading…
chat_description: Messages sent here pop up on %1$s's screen (it needs a desktop session and a browser for that to work). Anything typed back there shows up here.
status_still_signing_in: Still finishing sign-in, try again in a moment.
chat_sent_as_push: Sent as a push notification as the device wasn't connected.
chat_not_delivered: Message couldn't be delivered as the device wasn't connected.
terminal_waiting: Still waiting for output. This can mean the device requires approval before a session starts (check its screen for a prompt), or something else is blocking the session. Check the byte counter above, it will show 0 the whole time if nothing is arriving at all.
files_error_device_write: The device could not write the file.
files_error_transfer_in_progress: Another transfer is already in progress.
files_error_create_in_folder: Couldn't create the file in the chosen folder
files_error_open_folder: Couldn't open the chosen folder for writing
files_delete_folder_confirm: Delete "%1$s" and everything inside it? This can't be undone.
desktop_type_to_send: Type to send to remote screen
